name: io.github.astandrik/ydb-qdrant-mcp
title: YDB Qdrant MCP
description: Index local code into YDB Qdrant and search indexed code memory.

environmentVariables.name: YDB_QDRANT_DATABASE
environmentVariables.description: YDB database path used by ydb-qdrant.

environmentVariables.name: YDB_QDRANT_MCP_WORKSPACE_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Default local repository root for index_repository.

environmentVariables.name: YDB_QDRANT_MCP_ALLOWED_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated allowlist for explicit root arguments. Defaults to YDB_QDRANT_MCP_WORKSPACE_ROOT.

environmentVariables.name: YDB_QDRANT_MCP_LOCAL_NAMESPACE
environmentVariables.description: Optional namespace component for local index IDs when multiple machines share one YDB database.

environmentVariables.name: YDB_QDRANT_MCP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional core vector MCP API-key identity. Mutually exclusive with YDB_QDRANT_MCP_USER_UID.

environmentVariables.name: YDB_QDRANT_MCP_USER_UID
environmentVariables.description: Optional core vector MCP explicit user namespace. Mutually exclusive with YDB_QDRANT_MCP_API_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: CODE_INDEXER_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Embedding provider for local code indexing: hash, http, or openai.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer MCP token created in the YDB Qdrant Code Indexer dashboard.
